mapper.select: SELECT a.RECORD_ID AS recordId, -- 答卷记录ID a.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, -- 答卷创建时间 a.ANSWER_INFO AS answerInfo, -- 答卷JSON a.QUESTION_ID AS questionId, -- 问卷ID (SELECT MAX(v.DISPOSE_RESULT) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS disposeResult, -- 意见箱-处理结果 (SELECT MAX(v.DIVISION_NAME) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS divisionName, -- 意见箱-科室名称 (SELECT MAX(v.STATUS) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS adviceStatus -- 意见箱-处理状态(0未回复 1已回复 2无需回复) FROM SFP_QUESTION_ANSWER a WHERE a.CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate} AND a.CREATE_TIME < #{endDate} + 1 AND INSTR(a.ANSWER_INFO, '173823541780282343918') > 0 ORDER BY a.CREATE_TIME DESC
